metadata.title: Topk backward twice (the second input is NAN) to trigger cuda assert.

bug_description:
## 🐛 Bug



Topk backward twice (the second input is NAN) to trigger cuda assert.

trigger_conditions.condition: Calling differentiable operators with CUDA tensors containing NaN or Inf values and performing backward computation.
trigger_conditions.operation_context: A CUDA tensor with requires_grad=True containing NaN values is passed to torch.topk, and the output is used for backward.

failure_behavior.description: A CUDA tensor with requires_grad=True containing NaN values is passed to torch.topk, and the output is used for backward.
